text: Men jaabinani mo toraare makko nden, Men Okki mo Yahyaa ɓiɗɗo, Men moƴƴini sonnaajo makko on, o wonti jibinoowo ɓaawo hari o laatinoke dimaro, pellet, Jakariyaa e sonna makko e geɗaljo makko on ɓe laatinoke hiɓe heñoo faade e gollugol moƴƴi ɗin, ɓe laatinoke hiɓe nodda Men hara ko ɓe rerɗuɓe ko woni kon ka Amen immorde mbarjaari ndin, hara ko ɓe huluɓe kon ko woni ka Amen immorde e lepte ɗen, ɓe woniino yankinaniiɓe Men.
